**Texere 0.4.13** · 12 November 2026

- **Focus mode.** **Ctrl/Cmd + Alt + F** hides everything except the files you have open (two side by side stay side by side): sidebars, ribbon, tabs, the note's top bar, the status bar. The same shortcut brings them back as they were. Change the shortcut in Settings → Hotkeys ("Texere: Focus mode").

Also in this version (from 0.4.12, 0.4.11): Reload after an update reloads all of Obsidian; clearer first steps on the home page.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page, or BRAT at startup.
